question: Who among the following sportsmen is the brand ambassador of SBOTOP, which is a global online betting platform?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dwayne Bravo**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dwayne Bravo is the brand ambassador of SBOTOP, which is a global online betting platform**__.

 __
 
• West Indies cricket icon Dwayne Bravo has become the first cricket ambassador for “SBOTOP” sportsbook brand.
 
• Isle of Man betting group Celton Manx has appointed the West Indies cricketer as the cricket ambassador for its flagship sportsbook.
 
• Dwayne Bravo has represented West Indies in all formats of cricket.
 
• **Sbotop is a provider of online Sportsbook, Casino & Virtual gaming services; all accessible from your desktop, mobile, or tablet device**.
 
• Dwayne John Bravo is a **Trinidadian cricketer** and a former captain of the West Indies cricket team.
 
• A genuine all-rounder, Bravo is a right-handed batsman and bowled right-arm medium-fast. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rohit Gurunath Sharma **is an Indian international cricketer.

 
 
• He is the captain of the Indian national team in limited-overs formats and the vice-captain in Test cricket.
 
• He is the **official Rhino Ambassador for WWF-India **and is a member of People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (PETA).
 
• He has worked with** PETA **in its campaign to raise awareness of the plight of homeless cats and dogs in India.
 
 
 
• **Sushil Kumar** is a former Indian wrestler.
 
 
• He carried the Indian flag at the opening ceremony of the **2012 London Olympics**.
 
• His 2008 Olympic medal was second for India in wrestling and the first since Khashaba Dadasaheb Jadhav's bronze medal at the 1952 Summer Olympics.
 
 
 
• **Bajrang Punia **is an Indian freestyle wrestler, who competes in the 65-kg weight category.
 
 
• At the 2020 Tokyo Olympics, Punia won a bronze medal by defeating Kazakhstan’s Daulet Niyazbekov with a wide 8-0 margin.
 
• Punia is the only Indian wrestler to win** 3 medals at the World Wrestling Championships**.
